name: Super Satanic Panic!; House Rules; Anansi's Web; Fear Knowing; Tricks! Treats! Comic Books!; Cat's Out of the Tomb; For Abby; The Lovers at Losthall Manor
title: DC's Quoth the Raven… Whatever #1
desc:
YOU EVER DANCE WITH THE DEVIL IN THE PALE MOONLIGHT?WHAT ABOUT WITH THE DAUGHTER OF DARKNESS?

Welcome, foolish mortals. Not far from the shores of Gotham City, when the nights grow long, the leaves turn red, and a certain crisp chill comes into the air on a twilight lit by the full moon, the lives of heroes and antiheroes from Raven to Swamp Thing, Constantine, Zatanna, Deadman, and more...turn toward the strange and unusual, the occult and delightful, the odd and the audacious.

For those looking to give themselves a good, warm dose of the shivers, this anthology of scary stories to tell in the dark is the perfect assortment of fairy tales for troubled times and troubled souls alike. Pick up a copy wherever needful things and comic books are sold. We think you'll find it the perfect companion to your handbook for the recently deceased.
